text: Keep original photo crop (corners bounding box + 50 px) and corner coordinates for later corrections
description: Instead of the whole raw photo: original.jpg (q90) = bounding box of the selected quad + 50 px margin, plus the corners relative to the crop and the crop offset in painting.json. Uploaded privately to R2 (variant 'original'). Enables re-rectifying with corrected corners later.
